primaryText: De mannen hebben Hans de paarden leren voeren.
translation: The men taught Hans to feed the horses.
comment: Word-by-word order: The men have Hans the horses teach feed.

primaryText: Die Männer haben Hans die Pferde füttern lehren.
translation: The men taught Hans to feed the horses.
comment: Word-by-word order: The men have Hans the horses feed teach.

primaryText: The men taught Hans to feed the horses.
translation: The men taught Hans to feed the horses.

primaryText: Jeanine heeft de mannen Hans de paarden helpen leren voeren.
translation: Jeanine helped the men teach Hans to feed the horses.
comment: Rejected outright by native speakers of Dutch as unacceptable.

primaryText: Johanna hat die Männer Hans die Pferde füttern lehren helfen.
translation: Johanna helped the men teach Hans to feed the horses.
comment: Rejected outright by native speakers of German as unacceptable.

primaryText: Joanna helped the men teach Hans to feed the horses.
translation: Joanna helped the men teach Hans to feed the horses.
comment: Only marginally more complex than (3) to a speaker of English; readily comprehensible.

primaryText: Karel heeft Jeanine de mannen Hans de paarden zien helpen leren voeren.
translation: Charles saw Joanna help the men teach Hans to feed the horses.
comment: Third level of embedding; clearly not normally acceptable.

primaryText: Karl hat Johanna die Männer Hans die Pferde füttern lehren helfen sehen.
translation: Charles saw Joanna help the men teach Hans to feed the horses.
comment: Third level of embedding; clearly not normally acceptable.

primaryText: Charles saw Joanna help the men teach Hans to feed the horses.
translation: Charles saw Joanna help the men teach Hans to feed the horses.

primaryText: De lerares heeft de knikkers opgeruimd.
translation: The teacher collected up the marbles.
comment: Sample test-set item. Mean comprehensibility rating 1.14 (1 = easy, 9 = hard).

primaryText: Die Lehrerin hat die Murmeln aufgeräumt.
translation: The teacher collected up the marbles.
comment: Sample test-set item.

primaryText: Jantje heeft de lerares de knikkers helpen opruimen.
translation: Jantje helped the teacher collect up the marbles.
comment: One level of embedding, two-verb cluster helpen-opruimen in crossed order.

primaryText: Wolfgang hat der Lehrerin die Murmeln aufräumen helfen.
translation: Wolfgang helped the teacher collect up the marbles.
comment: Infinitive version; the participle version ends in geholfen.

primaryText: Aad heeft Jantje de lerares de knikkers laten helpen opruimen.
translation: Aad let Jantje help the teacher collect up the marbles.
comment: Two levels of embedding, three-verb cluster laten-helpen-opruimen in crossed order.

primaryText: Arnim hat Wolfgang der Lehrerin die Murmeln aufräumen helfen lassen.
translation: Arnim let Wolfgang help the teacher collect up the marbles.
comment: Infinitive version; lassen appears only in the infinitive.

primaryText: Ingrid heeft Lotte de bewoners de blinde het eten horen leren helpen koken.
translation: Ingrid heard Lotte teach the residents to help the blind man to cook the food.
comment: Third level of embedding; separate nine-sentence set, mean rating 7.66.

primaryText: Ingrid hat Lotte die Bewohner dem Blinden das Essen kochen helfen lehren hören.
translation: Ingrid heard Lotte teach the residents to help the blind man to cook the food.
comment: Third level of embedding; mean rating 8.26 (infinitive version).

primaryText: Jantje heeft de lerares geholpen om de knikkers op te ruimen.
translation: Jantje helped the teacher collect up the marbles.
comment: Same propositions as the Level 2 test sentence, right-branching structure.

primaryText: Wolfgang hat der Lehrerin geholfen, die Murmeln aufzuräumen.
translation: Wolfgang helped the teacher collect up the marbles.

primaryText: Arnim hat Wolfgang dazu gebracht, der Lehrerin beim aufräumen der Murmeln zu helfen.
translation: Arnim got Wolfgang to help the teacher with collecting up the marbles.

primaryText: Henk heeft de kinderen Anneke de koeien laten zien melken.
translation: Henk let the children see Anneke milk the cows.
comment: Interpretation (12): P(let (H, (see (the children, (milk (A, the cows)))))).

primaryText: Hans hat die Kinder Anna die Kühe melken sehen lassen.
translation: Hans let the children see Anna milk the cows.
comment: Same interpretation (12) as the Dutch (10).

primaryText: Which sonatas are these violins easy to play on?
translation: Which sonatas are these violins easy to play on?
comment: Crossing long-distance dependencies; English listeners react markedly against these.

primaryText: Which violins are these sonatas easy to play on?
translation: Which violins are these sonatas easy to play on?
comment: Nested long-distance dependencies, contrasting with the crossed (13).

primaryText: Der Ball wurde durch das Fenster geworfen.
translation: The ball was thrown through the window.
comment: Fillers match the test levels in numbers of nouns and verbs but not in structure.
